vote: Plurality correctness with tie-as-abstain; exactly the frozen G/H/M semantics.
oracle: At least one valid member is correct.
pivotal: A correct member on a correct team whose leave-one-out peer margin is non-positive.
unique: A correct member when exactly one member is correct.
transfer_gap: Right-minus-left train vote accuracy minus right-minus-left held-out vote accuracy.
target_entropy: Shannon entropy of five target shares divided by log(5).
descriptive_efficiency: Final held-out vote gain versus S0 divided by accepted updates; not causal per-commit attribution.
recovery: Raw final-state right-minus-left differences; recovery fractions, where defined, are descriptive only.
